## Venice Uncensored 1.2 API

Venice Uncensored 1.2 is a large language model by Venice, available on the Venice API as `venice-uncensored-1-2`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Venice Uncensored 1.2 is designed for maximum creative freedom and authentic interaction. Built for open-ended exploration, roleplay, and unfiltered dialogue with improved capabilities over 1.1.

### Venice Uncensored 1.2 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `venice-uncensored-1-2` | Standard | Private | $0.20 / $0.90 per 1M |

### Venice Uncensored 1.2 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Venice |
| Released | Apr 1, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 128K tokens |
| Max output | 8K tokens |
| Served precision | FP16 |

### How to use the Venice Uncensored 1.2 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "venice-uncensored-1-2"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "venice-uncensored-1-2",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
